AppAlreadyRunning: MimiTap is already running. Check the tray icon.
CardPreviewTitle: This is how it looks over your windows
CardPreviewHint: Size, position and images apply immediately. Click “Save” to remember them for the next launch.
CardPreviewAssets: You can put your own files in %AppData%\MimiTap\assets as 1.png and 2.png.
PresetHint: Sets of Mimi frames: each has its own 1.png and 2.png pair. Switch between presets and give them your own names.
CardPositionHint: “Remember current” stores the character’s current position. Empty X / Y means the position is computed from the anchor.
CardClickHook: Track mouse and keyboard input system-wide
HitTestImage: Only the opaque pixels of the image
CardClickZoneInfo: The click zone is a rectangle around the character; clicking the empty space also switches the image.
CardClickScreenHint: In “Whole screen” mode any click anywhere switches the image: in a game, a browser or any app. While the settings window is open, only clicks on the character count. Dragging works only on the character itself.
ClickHold: Hold 2.png while an input is held
CardClickHoldHint: “Hold 2.png”: while any bound input is held — 2.png; the moment it is released — 1.png, no matter how long you held. The other modes trigger on release.
CardClickDragToMove: Drag the character with the mouse (hold the left button and pull)
CardClickClickThrough: Clicks pass through (the app under the character gets the click)
CardClickNoActivate: Do not steal focus from other windows
CardSoundFormats: Formats: wav, mp3, m4a, wma, aac. Long files are trimmed automatically (1 second max).
SoundNone: No sound selected — it will be silent.
CardSystemHotkeyHint: The hotkey is the only way to control the character while it is inactive. Right-click the character or the tray icon to open settings.
ConfirmReset: Reset all settings to their default values?
ZoneWarning: WARNING: the global mouse hook is not installed — clicks are not tracked.
ZoneHookOff: The hook is off: only the character itself handles input (unless clicking is disabled).
ZoneScreen: A click counts anywhere on the screen.
ZoneDetails: Character {0}×{1} px, click zone {2}×{3} px (X: {4}…{5}, Y: {6}…{7}). Clicking the empty space around the character also switches it.
AboutText: MimiTap is a transparent character that sits on top of every window. At rest it shows 1.png (Mimi winding up); while the left button is held — 2.png (Mimi pressed).
AboutCharacterText: Mimi is an anthropomorphic dog, the original character and mascot of the artist Typh. She is known from the “Kiss Me” video meme.
AboutRights: The character and the artwork belong to the artist Typh — the MIT license does not cover them. The app’s code is released under MIT.
TutorialStep1Text: I live on top of every window and react to your clicks. Let me show you how to use me.
TutorialStep2Text: Hold the left mouse button anywhere — I “press” the button (2.png). Release it — back to the wind-up (1.png).
TutorialStep3Text: Right-clicking me opens the settings: size, position, sound and click behaviour.
TutorialStep4Text: Double-click the tray icon to hide or show me. The same menu holds settings and Exit.
TutorialStep5Text: Ctrl+Alt+M instantly shows or hides me. You can change the key in the settings.
InstallerIntro: Your click, her press. Hold the left mouse button — Mimi shows 2.png; release — back to 1.png. A click counts anywhere on the screen.
InstallerAutoStart: Start MimiTap with Windows (minimized to tray)
InstallerFooter: Settings and images are stored separately: %AppData%\MimiTap. The app lives in the tray and takes no space in the taskbar.
InstallerUninstallFooter: The app will be removed, shortcuts and autostart cleared.
InstallerNoAdmin: Installation does not require administrator rights.
InstallerDetailsAbove: See the installation log above for details.
InstallerClosingApp: Closing MimiTap if it is running…
InstallerRegistering: Registering the app in Programs and Features…
InstallerRemovingRegistry: Removing the Programs and Features entry…
InstallerErrRunKey: Could not open the autostart registry key.
InstallerErrNoPayload: The installer has no application payload — run publish first.

BindHint: Click a slot and press the key or mouse button you want — Mimi will press the button on that input. Mimi ignores empty slots.
BindPressKey: Press a key or mouse button…
BindClear: Right-click a slot to clear it
BindReactAll: React to any mouse or keyboard input
BindReactAllHint: When on, the list above doesn't matter: Mimi presses the button on any input. Handy for games and screen recording.
